query: What praise and complaints appear in IMDb reviews?

per_column.name: praise_terms
per_column.rationale: Praise is a direct constitutive half of 'praise and complaints'; captures the positive-evaluation aspect of the concept.

per_column.name: complaint_terms
per_column.rationale: Complaints are the other constitutive half of the concept; captures the negative-evaluation aspect.

per_column.name: sentiment_polarity
per_column.rationale: Overall polarity (positive/mixed/negative) restates the whole praise-vs-complaint balance rather than isolating a distinct aspect; it is a summary of the two facets, not a separate part.

per_column.name: praise_terms.1
per_column.rationale: Exact duplicate of praise_terms; adds no distinct facet and overlaps completely with the existing praise facet.

per_column.name: complaint_terms.1
per_column.rationale: Exact duplicate of complaint_terms; redundant with the existing complaint facet.

per_column.name: sentiment_polarity.1
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of sentiment_polarity; again a summary restatement, not a distinct facet.

judge.rationale: Only two genuine facets exist (praise_terms, complaint_terms), which correctly carve the concept into its two constitutive halves. However the set is badly compromised: three columns (praise_terms.1, complaint_terms.1, sentiment_polarity.1) are exact duplicates and sentiment_polarity is a summary restatement of the praise/complaint balance rather than a separate aspect. The heavy duplication and overlap crush mutual exclusivity. On exhaustiveness, praise and complaint terms cover the two poles but omit finer constitutive sub-facets (e.g., which target of praise/complaint: acting, plot, direction, pacing), so coverage of the concept's internal structure is only moderate.
